monetary.title: Monetary Integrity
monetary.description: Every coin ForceX publishes is backed by a real, unspent output and reconciles against the independent Litecoin node.

address.title: Address Integrity
address.description: Address balances, received totals, sent totals, and transaction counts all reconcile across ForceX's address ledger and its per-transaction links.

block_write.title: Block & Write Integrity
block_write.description: Block composition and write-path commitments are verified against the data ForceX actually stored for each block.

FX-LVR-001.title: Address balance reconciliation
FX-LVR-001.meaning: Every coin held by an address is backed by a real, unspent output on the chain.
FX-LVR-001.what_it_checks: Total balance across all addresses reconciles with the unspent-output set at the validated tip.
FX-LVR-001.why_it_matters: Prevents silent drift between what ForceX says users hold and what the chain actually shows as unspent.
FX-LVR-001.technical_basis: ForceX reconciles address balance changes against transparent UTXO creation and spend activity over the validated interval.

FX-LVR-002.title: MWEB pool conservation
FX-LVR-002.meaning: The confidential MWEB pool balance reconciles with the sum of all pegins, pegouts, and fees since the last anchor.
FX-LVR-002.what_it_checks: The current MWEB pool balance equals the last trusted anchor balance plus the net flow recorded since that anchor.
FX-LVR-002.why_it_matters: MWEB outputs are confidential — the pool balance is the only public anchor for the entire confidential ledger. Conservation here is the difference between provable supply and unprovable supply.
FX-LVR-002.helps_prevent: Internal accounting drift across the confidential ledger.
FX-LVR-002.technical_basis: ForceX reconciles MWEB pool balance movement against peg-in activity, peg-out activity, and fee-related net flow over the validated interval.

FX-LVR-003.title: Address received reconciliation
FX-LVR-003.meaning: Every coin recorded as received by an address matches a real output paid to that address.
FX-LVR-003.what_it_checks: The total received value per address reconciles against the source transaction outputs paying to that address over the same window.
FX-LVR-003.why_it_matters: The 'Total received' figure shown on every address page must match what the chain actually paid that address — never over- or under-counted.
FX-LVR-003.helps_prevent: Internal accounting drift in the address ledger.
FX-LVR-003.technical_basis: ForceX reconciles address-level received totals against transparent outputs attributed to those addresses over the validated interval.

FX-LVR-004.title: Address sent reconciliation
FX-LVR-004.meaning: Every coin recorded as sent by an address matches a real input spent from that address.
FX-LVR-004.what_it_checks: The total sent value per address reconciles against the source transaction inputs spending from that address over the same window.
FX-LVR-004.why_it_matters: The 'Total sent' figure on every address page must match what the chain actually spent from that address.
FX-LVR-004.helps_prevent: Internal accounting drift in the address ledger.
FX-LVR-004.technical_basis: ForceX reconciles address-level sent totals against transparent input spend activity attributed to those addresses over the validated interval.

FX-LVR-005.title: Address received cross-reconciliation
FX-LVR-005.meaning: Address-level received totals and per-transaction received links agree with each other.
FX-LVR-005.what_it_checks: Address-ledger received totals reconcile against the sum of received values recorded in address-to-transaction links for the same window.
FX-LVR-005.why_it_matters: Two independently built views of the same data must agree — if they diverge, one of them is wrong.
FX-LVR-005.helps_prevent: Divergence between the address ledger and its transaction link index.
FX-LVR-005.technical_basis: ForceX reconciles address received totals against the recorded per-transaction received value linked to each address over the validated interval.

FX-LVR-006.title: Address sent cross-reconciliation
FX-LVR-006.meaning: Address-level sent totals and per-transaction sent links agree with each other.
FX-LVR-006.what_it_checks: Address-ledger sent totals reconcile against the sum of sent values recorded in address-to-transaction links for the same window.
FX-LVR-006.why_it_matters: Two independently built views of the same data must agree — if they diverge, one of them is wrong.
FX-LVR-006.helps_prevent: Divergence between the address ledger and its transaction link index.
FX-LVR-006.technical_basis: ForceX reconciles address sent totals against the recorded per-transaction sent value linked to each address over the validated interval.

FX-LVR-007.title: Address transaction count reconciliation
FX-LVR-007.meaning: The transaction count on each address matches the number of recorded transaction links for that address.
FX-LVR-007.what_it_checks: Address-ledger transaction counts reconcile against the actual number of transaction links stored for each address.
FX-LVR-007.why_it_matters: The transaction count on an address page must match the number of transactions you can actually list for that address.
FX-LVR-007.helps_prevent: Divergence between the address ledger and its transaction link index.
FX-LVR-007.technical_basis: ForceX reconciles address transaction counts against the number of recorded transaction links associated with each address over the validated interval.

FX-LVR-008.title: MWEB pool write-path verification
FX-LVR-008.meaning: The MWEB pool balance stored after each MWEB block matches the balance the parser was tracking in memory.
FX-LVR-008.what_it_checks: After each MWEB block is processed, the pool balance ForceX records matches the running balance it tracked during block processing.
FX-LVR-008.why_it_matters: Catches write-path corruption immediately on the block it occurred, before any downstream metric is affected.
FX-LVR-008.helps_prevent: Write-path corruption or incomplete ingestion of MWEB blocks.
FX-LVR-008.technical_basis: ForceX verifies that the MWEB balance state committed to storage matches the balance state tracked during live block processing.

FX-LVR-009.title: Rolling snapshot reconciliation
FX-LVR-009.meaning: The current chain-state snapshot used by the explorer is anchored to the real tip and has not drifted from source.
FX-LVR-009.what_it_checks: The rolling snapshot’s tip height, block count, transaction count, and pool balance reconcile against ForceX’s current indexed chain state at each new block.
FX-LVR-009.why_it_matters: The summary numbers shown across the explorer come from this snapshot — if it drifts from source, every surface is subtly wrong.
FX-LVR-009.helps_prevent: Stale or misaligned snapshot data leaking into explorer summaries.
FX-LVR-009.technical_basis: ForceX reconciles the explorer’s rolling chain snapshot against live indexed chain-state totals and current tip state.

FX-LVR-010.title: Block transaction count match
FX-LVR-010.meaning: The transaction count stored on each block matches the transactions actually written for that block.
FX-LVR-010.what_it_checks: The transaction count shown for each block matches the transactions ForceX recorded for that block.
FX-LVR-010.why_it_matters: Catches partial-write or duplicate-write bugs on the block they occurred.
FX-LVR-010.helps_prevent: Write-path corruption producing inconsistent block metadata.
FX-LVR-010.technical_basis: ForceX reconciles each block’s stored transaction count against the transactions committed for that block during ingestion.

FX-LVR-011.title: Issued supply cap verification
FX-LVR-011.meaning: The total spendable LTC on the chain never exceeds what the Litecoin halving schedule says can exist.
FX-LVR-011.what_it_checks: The total unspent-output value at the validated tip is no greater than the deterministic issued supply for that height under Litecoin's halving schedule.
FX-LVR-011.why_it_matters: A supply violation would mean ForceX is reporting more coins than can possibly exist — an unambiguous integrity failure.
FX-LVR-011.helps_prevent: Internal accounting drift producing impossible supply totals.
FX-LVR-011.technical_basis: ForceX validates indexed spendable supply against Litecoin’s deterministic issuance schedule at the current validated height.

FX-LVR-012.title: Block input count match
FX-LVR-012.meaning: The input count stored on each block matches the inputs actually written for that block.
FX-LVR-012.what_it_checks: The input count shown for each block matches the inputs ForceX recorded for that block.
FX-LVR-012.why_it_matters: Catches partial-write or miscounted-input bugs on the block they occurred.
FX-LVR-012.helps_prevent: Write-path corruption producing inconsistent block metadata.
FX-LVR-012.technical_basis: ForceX reconciles each block’s stored input count against the committed input records written for that block.

FX-LVR-013.title: Block output count match
FX-LVR-013.meaning: The output count stored on each block matches the outputs actually written for that block.
FX-LVR-013.what_it_checks: The output count shown for each block matches the outputs ForceX recorded for that block.
FX-LVR-013.why_it_matters: Catches partial-write or miscounted-output bugs on the block they occurred.
FX-LVR-013.helps_prevent: Write-path corruption producing inconsistent block metadata.
FX-LVR-013.technical_basis: ForceX reconciles each block’s stored output count against the committed output records written for that block.

FX-LVR-014.title: Independent node cross-check
FX-LVR-014.meaning: The total UTXO amount ForceX has indexed matches what the Litecoin node itself reports.
FX-LVR-014.what_it_checks: The ForceX UTXO total at a checkpointed height cross-checks against the Litecoin node's independent UTXO total at the same height.
FX-LVR-014.why_it_matters: The only layer that verifies ForceX against a system outside itself. Catches drift between an internally self-consistent index and source truth.
FX-LVR-014.helps_prevent: Source divergence — internal self-consistency while drifting from Litecoin node truth.
FX-LVR-014.technical_basis: ForceX cross-checks indexed UTXO-equivalent supply against Litecoin node-reported chain state at controlled checkpoint heights.
